source: Original native Codex, provider-boundary, proxy, bridge and CloudWatch captures from one completed real research run

capture-status.json.transformation: CRLF normalized to LF for portable evidence hashes; all field values unchanged.

cloudwatch.json.transformation: Metadata allowlist; discard auth/account/resource attributes, tool arguments/results/schemas/descriptions and model content. Original IDs, parent IDs, timestamps and selected attributes retained unchanged.

codex-result-link.json.transformation: Keep original native completed-item IDs and returned session; remove model prose, arguments and duration fields.

correlation: The native completed-item ID equals the OTLP call ID; its returned session equals the bridge session; the bridge explicitly records the incoming proxy session/request hash. correlation.jsonl is a derived, evidence-backed link, not an agent-emitted event.
limits: AWS inserts ingress parent spans absent from the 44-span export; sent trace IDs match but direct native parents do not. Preserve these gaps.
Service shutdown uses Ctrl-C; completed request pairs are checked separately from incomplete service manifests.
Cloud commentary is not recommendation validation; recommendations.json is the canonical local checked report.
Two optional RetrieveMemoryRecords calls returned 403 in this completed research run; their native ERROR status codes are retained. The scoped permission is being corrected separately.

inventory_sources.providers: Actual .env token scan, secret masks removed and path replaced. Agent bindings mapped to the active server implementation: provider github -> github-tool, notion -> notion-tool.
inventory_sources.aws: Runtime SDK credential-set fingerprint and separately typed STS role; explicit observed binding metadata, not a static-file credential discovery.
